name: Anfíbios: uma pata na Água, outra na Terra
description: This exhibition, organized by CIIMAR, focuses on amphibians, the most threatened group of vertebrates globally. It aims to raise public awareness about their ecological importance, the threats they face, and the need for their conservation in Portugal.
longDescription:
The exhibition "Anfíbios: uma pata na Água, outra na Terra" is organized by CIIMAR and will be on display at CMIA de Matosinhos. It runs from May 13 to November 30, 2026.

This event highlights amphibians, which are the most threatened group of vertebrates worldwide. In Portugal, these animals are often misunderstood and associated with popular myths.

The exhibition seeks to inform the public about the ecological significance of amphibians, the dangers they face, and the importance of their conservation efforts in Portugal. Admission is free.
